register.labelZh: ACT 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: act as 可以說明一個人、地方或物件擔任甚麼角色,或發揮甚麼作用。；act for 和 act on behalf of 可以清楚說明誰代表他人發言、作決定或處理事情。；act on 和 act upon 可以表示某人因應建議、消息、指示或警告而採取行動。；act something out 表示用動作把故事或事情演出來;act up 則表示搗蛋或表現頑皮。
register.summaryEn: Act as helps you explain the job or purpose that a person, place or object has. Act for and act on behalf of make it clear who is speaking, deciding or handling matters for somebody else. Act on and act upon help you show that somebody did something because of advice, information, instructions or a warning. Act something out describes showing a story or event through actions, while act up describes bad or difficult behaviour.

fixedVariable.variableEn: Keep the same people, things, time and meaning. When using it or them with act... out, place the word between ACT and OUT: act it out act them out Act for somebody, act on behalf of somebody and act on somebody’s behalf mean representing somebody. Act on or act upon something means using information, advice or a warning to decide what to do.
